newsitem.title: USA: Argentine bourse head says some firms planning IPO.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bourse head says some firms planning IPO.

text.p: Select Argentine companies in the mining, food and oil sectors are planning initial public offerings in the domestic stock market, said Julio Macchi, president of the Buenos Aires stock exchange.
"I'd say companies in the mining, food and oil sectors... are planning to issue their IPOs," Macchi told Reuters in New York.
The bourse official also downplayed the impact of a recent general strike on Argentina's stock market.
"We have noticed that this (strike) doesn't cause any fear -- neither in domestic nor foreign investors," Macchi said, stressing that democratic values remained solid in Argentina.
Macchi said that country members of the South American free trade zone (Mercosur) are studying new measures to improve integration among their stock exchanges.
"We should advance in the process of integration of the markets," Macchi said.
"Instead of competing with each other, we are creating accords whereby traders in one bourse can negotiate stocks that are listed on another bourse," he added.
Negotiations had advanced considerably, he said.
A major factor in shaping an integrated market would be the pending decisions by Brazilian regulators.
